{{Top}}
The '''Imperial Court''', also known as the '''Emperor's Court''', was the collective body of high ranking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officials with close ties the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Members of the Court were considered the political, military and social elite of the Empire.

==History==
During the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], this membership included [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]] (including those that sat on the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]]), senior bureaucrats such as [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]], [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], Imperial ministers, senior military leaders of [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]], [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR's]] [[Select Committee/Legends|Select Committee]], the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] (including the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]]) and the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]]. Other participants of the Court included members of the nobility (Imperial [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] and [[Baron/Legends|Barons]]), powerful business leaders and magnates, members of the Emperor's [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] (including the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]]/Emperor's Mages and Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]]), and the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]]. Before its [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]], members of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] were allowed to partake in the Emperor's Court.

Well known members included [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rufaan Tigellinus]], [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Alec Pradeux]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Traeda]], and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]], just to name a few.

During the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]], several Rebel partisans proceeded to raid the Imperial Palace and lynch any members of the Imperial Court they could find, including the President of the [[Department of Punishment|Bureau of Punishments]], the head of the Emperor's [[School of Torturers]], the court clothing designer, and various other minor servants of all ages, genders, and species regardless of whether they were actually guilty of any atrocities by the Empire or not. Leia when recalling this event also noted that many of their names weren't even reported.
